suggestion.topic: Python AsyncIO vs Threading: When to Stop Blocking Your Event Loop
suggestion.rationale: Addressing the massive search volume around asyncio vs threading. Developers constantly misuse threads for I/O-bound tasks or block the single-threaded event loop with synchronous calls, tanking performance.
suggestion.hook_angle: Stop using Python threads for I/O-bound tasks until you understand how the AsyncIO event loop actually handles cooperative multitasking under the hood.
